skeleton._comment: #350: the leased room behind inn_upstairs' hallway_door_a (gated on room_purchased). Walk-in only, no portals row; biome, sprites and floor swatch all reused. Perimeter is walls.segments with a gap at (4,6) for the exit door, so wall cells are never also in `blocked`; `blocked` is empty because nothing here reads solid.
skeleton._comment_mood: NO data/moods.json row yet (that file is the moods lane's this wave), so the grade is identity white at EVERY phase and no gate can catch it -- the row to add is queued verbatim in .lane-progress SEAM 1. player_room_loop's 07_room_night shot is the standing eye-check.

entities.observe: The hall on the other side, and a bolt on this side. The bolt is most of what the lease bought.

entities._comment: Second sleep site. `your_bed` upstairs is NOT moved or gated: a player who never leases keeps the free bed. Ladder rungs ascend, highest satisfied wins.
entities.observe: Made up tight, corners squared. Lyonette did that, and she will know if you undo it badly.

sleep_toast.text: Your own room, and a door you can shut behind you.
Your own room, and bedding aired for you rather than for whoever comes next.
Your own room, the best bedding in the house, and a shut door between you and all of Liscor.

entities.locked_toast: Your own footlocker. Nothing in it yet that needs a key.
entities.observe: A plain footlocker at the head of the bed, hasp and no lock. Everything you own would rattle around in it.

entities.locked_toast: The desk is yours to use. Nothing on it yet is asking to be done.
entities.observe: A narrow desk under the window, one drawer, and a pale ring where somebody set a cup down for a whole winter.

entities.locked_toast: Nothing on the shelves yet. Give it a season.
entities.observe: Three shelves and you have filled none of them. Depending on the hour that is a sad thing or a hopeful one.

entities.locked_toast: You hang the day's coat and it stays hung. It is a small thing and it is not nothing.
entities.observe: Pegs worn pale at the shoulder height of forty travellers who hung a coat here and went away again.

floor_layers._pick: The pale swept board [16,21]/[17,21] the inn's own upstairs uses for its bedroom corner, so the room you bought is floored like the corner that was already yours. Same sheet, same licence, same wood footsteps.
One warmer plank band under the bed wall, from the inn's hall swatch, so the room is not one flat tone edge to edge.

skeleton.interior_flavor: Nothing there — just your own four walls, and the particular quiet of a room nobody else is paying for.
